comparison.objective: Transfer six crackers to a serving basket while excluding a desiccant packet.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated discrimination and delicate pick-and-place of small rigid surrogates.
comparison.success_condition: All crackers enter the basket; packet contact with the basket permanently zeros the score.
comparison.reason: Although both involve small-object handling and exclusion, this task tests food/package classification and transfer, not fracture generation, tool impact, retained-coil protection, or post-fracture search.
